create_model.coverage_note: The model_type selector has family-specific catalogs under model_families. Suggestions must use the selected model_type and applies_to_model_types; options must never be unioned.

gaps.reason: Family catalogs cover documented CREATE MODEL syntax for all 23 ordinary model types. Remote-model variants are outside current grammar; alternate modes and value-dependent restrictions still require their references.
Official syntax supports Python options, but current grammar only has SQL/JavaScript function branches.
Official Spark options are cataloged separately, but current grammar only supports SQL BEGIN/END procedure bodies.
The shared LOAD DATA table includes external-only Bigtable/object/metadata keys. They are excluded from load-file suggestions and retained separately for audit.
Grammar accepts VIEW/MATERIALIZED VIEW LIKE variants absent from referenced official CREATE TABLE LIKE syntax; use statement-kind scopes only when valid.
